messages:
Priya (docs): Heads-up: TypeScript SDK 2.0.0-alpha is published. Biggest change is the response envelope for generation APIs: we now return a structured object with { content, tokens, meta } instead of the legacy plain string. This affects generate() and chat.generate() callsites.

Marco (eng-ts): Why the switch?

Priya (docs): Goals: consistent metadata (per-token timing, token-level logprobs in future), better streaming boundaries, and parity with other SDKs' structured outputs.

Hana (product): Important: this is a breaking shape change for customers who de-structure results as strings. Is there a migration path?

Marco (eng-ts): We added a client-side compatibility flag `legacyText: true` that will make 2.0 return the old string shape for callers who opt-in. By default 2.0 returns the new object. Server accepts both shapes for 45 days. After 45 days server will start returning 400 for legacy-only clients unless they enable the compatibility header.

Riley (devex): Can we provide a small migration snippet to make the change trivial?

Priya (docs): Migration example pasted below for quick copy/paste. We'll add it to the Quickstart, the changelog, and a devblog post.

```ts
// OLD (v1.x)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-ts'
const client = new Redwood()
const text = await client.generate("Write a haiku about deployment")
console.log(text)

// NEW (v2.0)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-ts'
const client = new Redwood()
const resp = await client.generate("Write a haiku about deployment")
// resp shape: { content: string, tokens: string[], meta: { model: string, duration_ms: number } }
console.log(resp.content)
```

Omar (qa): Quick note: examples repo `examples/ts-quickstarts` has a handful of tests that assert direct string output. I'll open a PR to update those to assert `resp.content`. We should also add an e2e that tests both shapes.

Marco (eng-ts): Added runtime header support: `X-Redwood-Legacy-Response: true` for tenants who need extra time. Also wired a feature flag so we can roll the server-side enforcement region-by-region.

Hana (product): Customer comms plan: 1) Console banner for all tenants tomorrow, 2) tenant-targeted email to heavy TS users (>500k tokens/month) with migration notes, 3) changelog + blog. Jordan (release) on cc for scheduling.

Priya (docs): docs-bot: created changelog entry -> https://redwood.example.com/changelog/ts-2.0.0-alpha

docs-bot: :white_check_mark: changelog updated by Priya (docs).

Riley (devex): Also adding a lint rule to the examples repo that flags using `await client.generate(...)` as a bare string usage; prefer `resp.content`. Will push the rule as a separate PR.

Omar (qa): CI note: the alpha package is published to npm dist-tag `alpha`. Please do not pin `latest` in examples. I'll add a job that runs examples against both `alpha` and `latest` to catch any regressions.

Marco (eng-ts): Timeline recap: alpha published now, compatibility flag available now, server accepts legacy for 45 days, enforcement rollout starts after 45 days. We'll remove the client `legacyText` shim in the 2.1 stable release after we complete the enforcement window.

Hana (product): Can docs include an automated diff snippet for common patterns? e.g. `const text = await client.generate(...)` -> `const { content } = await client.generate(...)` — short find/replace examples will help adoption.

Priya (docs): Yep, adding a small migration helper and a one-liner codemod for TS devs to the migration guide.

Marco (eng-ts): If any customers break, notify @Marco (eng-ts) and @Hana (product) for warm rollback or grace window extension.

Priya (docs): Action checklist: 1) Docs migration guide + codemod published (done), 2) Quickstart updated (PR open), 3) Console banner scheduled (release), 4) Targeted emails queued, 5) Examples updated by QA PRs.

Hana (product): Thanks all. Small ask: include an explicit note in the migration guide about streaming clients and how to access partial tokens from the new envelope.

Priya (docs): Will add streaming FAQ with snippet for incremental token consumption.

Priya (docs): Closing the thread — if you want the 1:1 migration checklist for a tenant, DM me.
